title: The Parole Bond Bounty
logline: A predatory bail bondsman inflates an ex-convict's discharge ledger with fictitious administrative penalties, prompting an armed skip toward unpatrolled outer-rim moorings.

roles.description: Underwrites release bonds for parolees; calculates compound interest on every breath and tracks defaulters relentlessly.
An ex-convict hauler striving to rebuild an honest trade route; exhausted, vigilant, terrified of losing her ship back to the cells.
A patched light freighter operated by {role:paroled_hauler}, mortgaged to the bondsman under an indenture lien.
A customized patrol interceptor hired by the bondsman to disable skips before they cross the jump gate.
The administrative station mooring where parole indentures and release filings are logged.
An unregulated outer-rim mooring where independent haulers take cash jobs without transponder checks.

public_situation: Station authorities in {system} have posted a recovery warrant for {role:parolee_freighter} after it departed without clearing indenture fees.
private_truth: {role:parole_bondsman} inflated {role:paroled_hauler}'s release interest rates with bogus penalties to force the pilot into permanent indentured freight runs.

beats.public_change: The administrative registry issues an amber skip alert for {role:parolee_freighter} across system channels.

missions.reason: The bondsman hires an outside pilot to analyze the records dock comms beacon to isolate the freighter's departure vector.
missions.private_fact: He knows an audit is scheduled tomorrow that would reveal he added fictitious recovery fees to the parole contract.

beats.public_change: Customs officers at {role:free_freight_cove} receive an expedited seizure notice against {role:parolee_freighter}.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to deliver an expedited interdiction writ to dockmasters before the hauler can refuel and jump.
missions.private_fact: He forged the magistrate stamp on the writ because official authorization takes three business days.

beats.public_change: {role:bounty_enforcer} corners {role:parolee_freighter} in open space near the outer jump buoy.

missions.reason: The bondsman contracts the pilot to disable the fleeing freighter's sublight engines so his enforcer can attach tow cables.
missions.private_fact: {role:paroled_hauler} hails to offer decrypted ledger chips showing the bondsman doubled her debt if the pilot turns and disables {role:bounty_enforcer}.

player_choice.prompt: The enforcer is disabled and {role:paroled_hauler} waits with the decrypted debt ledgers. The pilot must decide where the proof goes.

options.label: Cover the freighter's jump so the hauler can start fresh in the rim
Take the doctored ledgers to the records dock magistrate to void the bond

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the freighter, allowing the bondsman to impound the ship and enforce the indenture.
resolutions.summary: {role:parole_bondsman} impounds {role:parolee_freighter}, forcing {role:paroled_hauler} into an extended indentured hauling contract to cover inflated recovery fees.

consequences.public_summary: A bounty runner helped an orbital bondsman drag a desperate parolee back into debt bondage.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the enforcer and covers the freighter's jump into the outer rim.
resolutions.summary: {role:paroled_hauler} jumps {role:parolee_freighter} to unpatrolled rim territory. {role:parole_bondsman} loses his bond stake and faces mounting creditor scrutiny.

consequences.public_summary: A hired gun turned on a loan shark's enforcer to let a debt-trapped parolee make the jump.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the decrypted ledger chips to the records magistrate at {role:penal_records_dock}.
resolutions.summary: The magistrate voids {role:paroled_hauler}'s bond after reviewing the forged penalties. {role:parole_bondsman} faces heavy regulatory fines and an operational suspension.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot brought doctored bail accounts to the magistrate, breaking an extortion ring on parolees.

resolutions.reached_by: The trail goes cold, or the pilot avoids taking contracts.
resolutions.summary: {role:bounty_enforcer} cripples {role:parolee_freighter} at the jump buoy, but {role:paroled_hauler} escapes on an unmarked tanker, leaving {role:parole_bondsman} holding a worthless wreck.

loose_threads.detail: The parole indenture slates bear interest multipliers coded to an anonymous escrow desk on an outer moon.
The magistrate seizure authorization is stamped with an electronic signet belonging to an inspector retired three years ago.
A salvage brokerage listed {role:parolee_freighter} on an advance repo auction two days before the hauler was declared delinquent.

radio_hooks: Administrative registry issues recovery alert for uncertified freighter departure in {system}.
Independent haulers protest rising surety bond rates demanded by dockside parole agencies.
Bounty chasers congregate near outer gate beacons following reports of a high-value skip.

voice_direction.parole_bondsman: Fast-talking, condescending, constantly citing subsection numbers. Speaks as though everything in the cosmos is already mortgaged to him.
voice_direction.paroled_hauler: Low, raspy delivery with tight, guarded sentences. Pauses before answering as if checking every word for an administrative trap.
